subject.title: feat(clients): adopt model controls, session management, and keyboard history recall on iOS

question: Should iOS retire the device-local SessionGroupStore in favor of the gateway-backed shared group contract, including a migration/retirement policy for existing local groups?
rationale: The patch currently exposes two persistent group models through reachable iOS entry points; selecting the canonical user-state owner and any upgrade behavior is a product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical fix.

options.title: Unify on gateway groups
options.body: Move the remaining iOS Sessions destination to the shared gateway-backed sheet and explicitly migrate or retire existing local groups.

options.title: Keep local groups deliberately
options.body: Retain the local catalog only with a documented distinct purpose and clear UI separation so users cannot mistake it for the gateway group model.

recommendation.title: Unify on gateway groups
recommendation.body: Move the remaining iOS Sessions destination to the shared gateway-backed sheet and explicitly migrate or retire existing local groups.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor carried the recent merged shared/native chat parity work and is the strongest available routing candidate for the intended group ownership model.
